text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even in their Senior Year,
the clash between these Umamusume was blazing hot!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just like her younger sister, the elder sister is strong too!!
Biwa Hayahide is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Good work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time, I'll win for sure.
See ya."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Saying 'her big sister is strong too'...
Of course she's strong.
She's Hayahide, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think so too.
I was able to deliver the absolute best run I could right now.

...Watching her smile like that,
a sudden thought crosses my mind.
choice_data_list: (If only I had known it was Hanshin from the start...)

text_block_list.text:
Could she have delivered an even more spectacular run?
Something truly—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian. To think she'd win
while setting an unexpected course record...!

"The kind that could even
set a course record...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, Trainer-kun.
What are you pondering in silence?"
choice_data_list: That you could've run an even better race...
They said you could've run an even better race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. That mindset is essential.
I agree that one must never be satisfied with their current results.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is true that, as I am now,
I cannot claim to stand at the pinnacle of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why I want to challenge the Takarazuka Kinen next.

The Takarazuka Kinen... A race where only Umamusume with both popularity and proven skill may run.
And also—
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, right?
The Takarazuka Kinen is held at Hanshin, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Though the distance differs,
it is held right here at Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. Don't tell me you're
still dwelling on what happened?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. It's not like anyone could help
that the venue had to be changed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, let's think about what's next.
First, let's identify the Umamusume
most likely to run in the Takarazuka Kinen—

—And so, together with Biwa Hayahide,
I pushed forward with preparations for the Takarazuka Kinen.
This time for sure, in order to draw out the very best run she is capable of...!
